theorems.name: Submission.lower_lipschitz_cover_of_local_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → F) (R : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))), Continuous f → MeasurableSet R → (∀ w ∈ R, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖u‖ ≤ c → c * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖f (w + u) - f w‖) → ∃ T : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), R ⊆ ⋃ p, T p ∧ ∀ p, MeasurableSet (T p) ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (T p) ∧ T p ⊆ R ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ T p, ∀ w ∈ T p, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖f v - f w‖
